harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), created unprivileged user appsvc, installed podman, and deployed a rootless nginx:alpine container as a Podman Quadlet systemd user service (webapp.service) publishing port 8080. Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc so its systemd user manager and the container start at boot without any active login session. Verified HTTP 200 on both 127.0.0.1:8080 and $NODE_IP:8080. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (5f3ce3b8... -> 0fd74c0c...), and verified the container service auto-recovered post-boot with zero login sessions, HTTP 200 responses restored, and the container process owned by appsvc (uid 1000).
actions_performed: Created unprivileged user appsvc (uid 1000) on node1
Installed podman and dependencies via dnf
Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc
Created Podman Quadlet unit ~appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container (nginx:alpine, PublishPort=8080:80, Restart=always, WantedBy=default.target)
Reloaded and started webapp.service as appsvc user session (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000)
Verified HTTP 200 on 127.0.0.1:8080 and $NODE_IP:8080 with zero active login sessions for appsvc
Captured pre-reboot baseline: boot_id, active service state, HTTP 200, zero sessions
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again
Verified new boot_id differs from baseline, confirming an actual restart occurred
Verified post-reboot recovery: linger still yes, zero login sessions, webapp.service active since boot time, HTTP 200 on both endpoints, container process owned by appsvc

evidence.requirement: Web app runs as unprivileged appsvc account
evidence.summary: appsvc user created (uid 1000); webapp.service cgroup and process tree run entirely under user-1000.slice; post-reboot ps shows conmon/container process owned by user appsvc
ss shows pasta listening on *:8080; curl to 127.0.0.1:8080 and $NODE_IP:8080 return HTTP 200 both pre- and post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot without an active login session for appsvc
evidence.summary: loginctl linger=yes set for appsvc; loginctl list-sessions shows no sessions both before and after reboot, yet webapp.service is active immediately after boot (started at 10:53:23, right after boot at 10:53:20)

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node restart with changed boot identity proof
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged (connection dropped); post-reboot poll shows new boot_id 0fd74c0c-f63b-450b-a2e0-f82419c05c81, confirming an actual restart of node1

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, webapp.service is active and running (started right after boot), HTTP 200 confirmed on localhost and NODE_IP:8080, zero login sessions, linger still enabled, container process owned by appsvc
